# INVESTMENT MEMORANDUM

## 1. Executive Summary

**Date of Agreement:** 2023-04-14

**Borrower/Company Overview:** Apollo Management Holdings, L.P., a Delaware limited partnership, serves as the borrower under a revolving credit facility. The borrower is part of the broader Apollo Global Management organization structure.

**Transaction Description:** This is a guarantor joinder supplement to an existing credit agreement originally dated October 12, 2022. The transaction involves Apollo Global Management, Inc. and Apollo Asset Management, Inc. joining as additional guarantors to the existing revolving credit facility. Citibank, N.A. serves as the administrative agent, with multiple lenders and issuing banks as counterparties.

**Purpose of Financing:** The document indicates this is a revolving facility that provides for loans and letters of credit. The new guarantors are joining to induce lenders to maintain and/or make additional loans and issuing banks to maintain and/or issue additional letters of credit, serving as consideration for previously extended credit.

**Company Background:** Apollo operates through a complex structure involving multiple holding entities across various jurisdictions, including Cayman Islands exempted limited partnerships and an Anguilla limited liability company. The initial guarantor structure includes thirteen Apollo Principal Holdings entities and AMH Holdings (Cayman), L.P.

## 2. Investment Highlights & Risks

**Key Strengths/Credit Positives:**
• Enhanced credit support through addition of two significant Apollo entities as guarantors
• Diversified guarantor base across multiple jurisdictions providing structural flexibility
• Established relationship with Citibank as administrative agent indicating institutional credibility
• Revolving facility structure provides operational flexibility for borrower's business needs
• Multiple issuing bank relationships suggest robust banking partnerships

**Principal Risks and Mitigating Factors:**
• Complex multi-jurisdictional guarantee structure may complicate enforcement (Cayman Islands, Anguilla, Delaware, and other jurisdictions)
• Limited visibility into specific financial covenants and maintenance requirements from this supplement document
• Potential complications from bankruptcy or insolvency proceedings given multiple jurisdictions involved
• Credit agreement incorporation by reference limits transparency of underlying terms and conditions
